author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a new tool Microsoft has launched in their evolving AI suite, one that seeks to grab your health information without any real legal safeguards for you. Companies like Microsoft keep pushing for this and it's time you understood how risky it is and why you shouldn't do it. Thanks for watching!

title: Microslop Wants Your Health Records Now...
